glosses: television (an electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound)
television set, TV set, television receiver, television, (colloquial) telly (a device for receiving television signals and displaying them in visual form)
television (collectively, the programs broadcast via the medium of television)

examples.text: Hay una televisión en mi habitación.
examples.en: There is a television in my room.
What did you watch on television last night?
